mainEntity.name: What does this book explain about AI in media?

acceptedAnswer.text: Where AI is already being used in media today — and where deadlines meet verification pressure.

mainEntity.name: Who gets the most value from this media guide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in journalism, including journalists, editors, platform teams, and readers tracking information systems.
